title: 第一部分 基础训练 TEST 2

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
### FAMILY FUN DAY

Do you want to have a good time with your family? If yes, come and join the family fun day!
* **When:** 3:00 pm to 4:45 pm, on July 19th
* **Where:** 1052 US Hwy 92 W, Auburndale
* **Plan:** play games, dance to the music and join the food party

Kids from 5 to 11 and their parents will be welcomed!
For more information, you can write to Juanita Halter at juanita@centralfloridamediagroup.com or call at 8633-248-7537.

questions.prompt: When will the family fun day start on July 19th?
options: A. At 1:15 pm.
B. At 3:00 pm.
C. At 4:45 pm.
D. At 7:45 pm.
questions.translation: 家庭欢乐日在7月19日什么时候开始？
questions.explanation: 根据海报中的“When: 3:00 pm to 4:45 pm, on July 19th”可知，活动于下午3:00开始。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: According to the poster, kids and parents can't ________ on the family fun day.
options: A. dance
B. play games
C. join a party
D. watch movies
questions.translation: 根据海报，孩子和家长在家庭欢乐日不能________。
questions.explanation: 根据海报中的“Plan: play games, dance to the music and join the food party”可知，活动包含玩游戏（B）、跳舞（A）和参加派对（C），没有看电影（D）。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: The family fun day will last ________.
options: A. 75 minutes
B. 95 minutes
C. 105 minutes
D. 115 minutes
questions.explanation: 根据“3:00 pm to 4:45 pm”可知，从下午3点到4点45分共计1小时45分钟，即105分钟。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: Who can come on the family fun day?
options: A. Lucy who is 4 years old.
B. Bob who is 7 years old.
C. Kate who is 13 years old.
D. Mike who is 15 years old.
questions.translation: 谁可以参加家庭欢乐日？
questions.explanation: 根据“Kids from 5 to 11 and their parents will be welcomed!”可知，欢迎5到11岁的小孩及其家长参加，7岁的Bob符合条件。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: How can we learn more information about the family fun day?
options: A. By calling at 8633-248-7573.
B. By asking Juanita Halter face to face.
C. By visiting 1052 US Hwy 92 W, Auburndale.
D. By e-mailing at juanita@centralfloridamediagroup.com.
questions.translation: 我们怎样才能了解更多关于家庭欢乐日的信息？
questions.explanation: 根据海报末尾“write to Juanita Halter at juanita@centralfloridamediagroup.com”可知，可以通过发邮件了解更多信息。A项中的电话号码8633-248-7573末两位数字写错（文中为8633-248-7537）。因此答案为D。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Each team has three players. The players are running and jumping in the hot sun. Music is all around. In just twelve minutes, the game is over. But a new one starts right away. How exciting!

This is streetball. It's much like basketball. But it's faster. People play it outside and it's interesting.

Usually, children play streetball on an open court. They use only half of the court. Children love lots of things about the game. "It's very nice to be outside in the sun. And the music is great," said Bai Xue, fourteen, a girl in Shenyang.

Some say streetball was from Europe. Others say it came from America. But now, boys and girls in many countries like to play it. Streetball is a game for all.

questions.prompt: How many players are there in each streetball team?
questions.translation: 每支街球队伍有多少名队员？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第一句“Each team has three players.”可知，每支队伍有3名队员。因此答案为C。

options: A. basketball
B. tennis
C. football
D. badminton
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“This is streetball. It's much like basketball.”可知，街头篮球和篮球很像。因此答案为A。

questions.prompt: Which of the following about streetball is NOT true?
options: A. Children use only half of the court.
B. Only girls like to play the game.
C. The game is over in twelve minutes.
D. People usually play streetball outside.
questions.translation: 关于街头篮球，下列哪项是不正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“now, boys and girls in many countries like to play it.”可知，男孩和女孩都喜欢玩，B项“只有女孩喜欢”描述错误。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: What's the best title for this passage?
options: A. Streetball: an exciting game
B. Different ball games
C. How to play streetball
D. Streetball and basketball
questions.translation: 这篇文章最佳的标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 通读全文，文章主要介绍了街头篮球（Streetball）这项令人激动的运动及特点，A选项“街头篮球：一项令人兴奋的运动”最切合主题。因此答案为A。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
A good breakfast is the best way to start your day. In China, people in different places eat different kinds of food for breakfast.

In many southern provinces, there are some breakfast foods made from rice. As we know, Southern China has grown rice for thousands of years. However, in the north of China, people usually eat breakfast foods made from wheat because the north grows wheat.

Different people like different tastes. Some people love to eat porridge and baozi. Some people love to eat youtiao and soy milk. There are also some famous breakfast foods in China. For example, people in Hunan Province love to eat rice noodles. They especially love spicy rice noodles. Do you know jianbing guozi? It is a popular breakfast food in Tianjin. But now, people in other places can buy it easily.

questions.prompt: Why do people in the south of China eat breakfast foods made from rice?
options: A. Because they are easy to make.
B. Because they can be bought easily.
C. Because rice is grown there.
D. Because there are very few other foods.
questions.translation: 为什么中国南方的人们吃大米制成的早餐食物？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Southern China has grown rice for thousands of years.”可知，因为中国南方盛产大米。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: What breakfast food does the writer NOT mention in the passage?
options: A. Porridge.
B. Youtiao.
C. Baozi.
D. Mantou.
questions.translation: 作者在文中没有提到哪种早餐食物？
questions.explanation: 文中提到了porridge（粥）、baozi（包子）、youtiao（油条）、soy milk（豆浆）、rice noodles（米粉）和jianbing guozi（煎饼果子），没有提到mantou（馒头）。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: From the passage, we can learn that ________.
options: A. jianbing guozi can only be bought in Tianjin
B. rice noodles are very popular in Hunan Province
C. Chinese people always eat the same breakfast foods
D. Chinese people only love to eat foods made from rice
questions.translation: 从文章中我们可以了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“people in Hunan Province love to eat rice noodles.”可知，米粉在湖南省非常受欢迎。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: The passage is written to introduce ________.
options: A. three meals in China
B. some Chinese breakfast foods
C. some popular foods in different places
D. why the Chinese eat different breakfast foods
questions.translation: 写这篇文章是为了介绍________。
questions.explanation: 通读全文，文章主要介绍了中国各地丰富多样的早餐食物（Chinese breakfast foods）。因此答案为B。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
This is a story about a boy named Kartik who loves playing football. Even though he only has one arm, he's really good at it.

Kartik and his sister, Kavya, move from Kolkata to Rourkela. They feel sad to leave their close friends behind. It's scary for Kartik because he thinks people at his new school will laugh at him because of his disability. Even though he tries to be friendly, he is not accepted by other students.

What's really hard for Kartik is that the football coach says he can't be on the team. The football field was like his home, where he felt the best. Now, it feels like he loses his home.

Can Kartik show everyone how much he loves football and be part of the team? Read the book Against All Odds to find out the answer. This book is great for teaching kids about never giving up.

questions.prompt: What do we know from this passage?
options: A. Kavya only has one arm.
B. Kavya is glad to move to a new city.
C. Kartik loves playing football and is good at it.
D. Kartik makes many friends at his new school.
questions.translation: 我们从这篇文章中能了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“This is a story about a boy named Kartik who loves playing football. Even though he only has one arm, he's really good at it.”可知，Kartik喜欢踢足球且很擅长。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: Why does Kartik feel sad when he moves to Rourkela?
options: A. Because he loses his football.
B. Because he leaves his sister.
C. Because he moves to a cold place.
D. Because he leaves his close friends behind.
questions.translation: 当Kartik搬到罗尔克拉时，为什么感到难过？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“They feel sad to leave their close friends behind.”可知，是因为离开了亲密的好朋友。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "accepted" mean in Chinese?
options: A. 夸赞
B. 放弃
C. 接受
D. 嘲笑
questions.translation: 画线单词“accepted”的中文意思是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据上下文“he is not accepted by other students.”可知，虽然他试图友好，但不被其他学生“接受”。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: What's really hard for Kartik at his new school?
options: A. The football field is terrible.
B. He can't be on the football team.
C. The teachers are very strict with his study.
D. He can't finish his homework on time.
questions.translation: 在新学校，对Kartik来说真正艰难的是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“What's really hard for Kartik is that the football coach says he can't be on the team.”可知，是足球教练说他不能加入球队。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: Kartik's story mainly tells us that ________.
options: A. never give up when we meet difficulties
B. playing sports can help us keep healthy
C. moving to a new city is not always bad
D. making a good friend is very important
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“This book is great for teaching kids about never giving up.”可知，故事告诉我们面对困难时要永不放弃。因此答案为A。
